mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a strengthening labor market and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and RSAFS rise) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by slowing housing starts, a decline in HOUST below 1300 thousand units signals an impending slowdown in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a tightening monetary policy coupled with weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rise and RSAFS decline) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.
